text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Deputies condemn U.S. strikes against Iraq.
- Prime Minister Kabariti reaffirms Jordan's desire to maintain Iraq's sovereignty, territorial integrity. Most of 572 Jordanian detainees in southern unrest freed; some will be sent to court.
- Parliament to reconvene in early October.
- Popular support for Jordan's stand on crisis in Iraq and refusal to join in attacks.
- PLO chief Yasser Arafat thanks King Hussein; Jordan welcomes Arafat-Netanyahu meeting.
- Kabariti says 521 out of 572 detainees released.
- Potash company director says new $9 million industrial potash plant to produce 100,000 tonnes a year.
